fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) combine fields from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block with the full article text parsed from HTML. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, parsed from the page's div.body-div HTML (article-mode).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section/category, from the page's breadcrumb link (not present in ld+json) (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from ld+json -- 'Saudi Gazette' (staff), 'Agencies' (wire), or 'By <Name>*' (opinion columns, kept verbatim) (article-mode).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from ld+json, always 'Saudi Gazette' on sampled articles (article-mode).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead image URL, flattened from the ld+json image object (article-mode).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords -- comma-separated string from ld+json (article-mode) or a list split from news:keywords (latest-mode). Sometimes CMS-auto-generated filler rather than curated tags.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the Google News sitemap (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
